symptom: A script that adds a column with `create or modify view entity` and aggregates over it (`sum $Rows by OpenCount`) was refused by check (and exec's preflight): 'ReproSummary has no member OpenCount — it has Dept, ItemCount'. Split into two scripts it built clean.
file: mdl/executor/validate_flow_member_refs.go scriptMemberModel.memberLink / nearMembers; validate.go scriptContext.viewEntityDecls. Test: mdl/executor/view_entity_authored_members_2463_test.go
cause: The flow member verdict read an entity's members from the script only for a `create entity`; a view entity the script declares was read from the stored model, which does not have the new column until the statement runs.
insight: **Every member resolver has to know every statement that declares members.** The script context recorded view entities as existing (sc.entities) but not their columns, so existence and membership disagreed. The test is an agreement test on a real project (check vs exec) with a control column that is still refused; a unit test on authoredMembers passed while the reported path stayed broken — it is a different resolver.
